room: Scout training classroom (school) furniture set v1: v3 look + world-map chalkboard and student desks from desks-v5b

how: The classroom was composed onto the SAME locked template as the Royal/nursery/kitchen rooms (scout-training-classroom-in-game-hex-meta.json: src_photo scout-training-classroom-source.png, src_verts TL(348.75,303.75) TR(776.25,303.75) R(1125,517.5) BR(1012.5,855) BL(112.5,855) L(45,517.5) -> dst_floor, hex width 790.97).
Back-wall (furniture) scale = template back edge / source back edge = 395.5/427.5 = 0.9251 (the compose back-wall map is affine: sx 0.9252, sy 1.557).

Pixel-match check: the source.png chalkboard region resized by exactly (0.9252, 1.557) matches the chalkboard in in-game-hex-no-outline-desks-v5b.jpg with NCC 0.972 at (445,431) (free search best: sx 0.92, sy 1.54). So the in-hex/v5b chalkboard is this source layer; source.png is its higher-resolution original and is used here.
v3 (shown to Chris) -> source.png: SIFT/RANSAC affine, 699/885 inliers, A=[[1.01147,-0.00144,-6.06],[-0.000145,1.01954,-5.01]]; area scale sqrt(det)=1.01550, so v3 factor = 0.9252 x 1.01550 = 0.9395.

Floor-homography x-scale cross-check at feet: globe foot 0.656, binoculars-table foot 0.569, desk 0.727, back edge 0.928 (front objects shrink in the compose perspective; the back-wall factor is what the Royal set used).
Uniform scale: the compose's vertical wall stretch (sy 1.557) is NOT applied.

Desks: the v5b desk is procedural (desks-v5-method.py). Re-running that exact construction gives desks-v5-wide-desk-sprite.png with max pixel diff 0 at its cell scale 0.21675 (room_scale of loop1-desk-study-v2, the old ~62 px ant). Rendered here at Albert's cell scale 130/287 = 0.45296 (same ant-to-desk ratio as v5b, Albert 130): desk-top front edge 108.7 px (v5b 52 px), sprite 181x173 (v5b 87x83), factor 2.0898 vs the v5b sprite. Cross-check: the original source.png desk top front edge ~112.6 px x 0.9252 = 104 px.

SIFT source.png -> in-game-hex-v1 (dark image, 5-12 inliers) gave sx 0.71-0.76 for clocks/maps/back-wall band; this does not agree with the meta compose (0.925) nor with the v5b pixel match (0.972 NCC at 0.9252) - in-hex-v1 is flagged as not the reference.
scale_derivation.alternative_not_used: scale-v1 intent: globe 0.16 x 92/43 = 0.342 of source px (old ~43 px ant re-targeted to Albert) - about 2.7x smaller than the compose factor; Chris said the v5b desks/globe were far too small, so not used.
